   HOMŒOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA

         by William BOERICKE, M.D.

          Presented by Médi-T



           FULIGO LIGNI

         Soot


Acts on glandular system, mucous membranes and obstinate ulcers,
        epidermis, tetters, eczema. Chronic irritations of mucous membranes of mouth;
        pruritus-vulvæ; uterine hæmorrhage; cancer, especially of scrotum-chimney sweeper's
        cancer; epithelial cancers; cancer of womb with metrorrhagia; sadness, thoughts of suicide.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Kreosot  .



Dose.--  Sixth trituration.
